definitions.gloss: refining; purification; processing to remove impurities
definitions.explanation: The process of removing unwanted substances to make something purer or more refined. Commonly used for food processing (sugar, oil), petroleum, metals, and chemicals.

examples.japanese: ⟦{石油|せきゆ}→石油：01448_sekiyu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{精製|せいせい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{精製|せいせい}⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{天然|てんねん}→天然：03560_tennen⟧⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧はどう⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: What is the difference between refined salt and natural salt?

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{原油|げんゆ}→原油：21637_genyu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{精製|せいせい}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ガソリン→ガソリン：01346_gasorin⟧や⟦{灯油|とうゆ}→灯油：04071_touyu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{生産|せいさん}している→生産する：01841_seisansuru⟧。
examples.english: This factory refines crude oil to produce gasoline and kerosene.

notes:
Composed of {精|せい} (refined, pure) and ⟦{製|せい}→〜製：02001_sei⟧ (manufacture). Describes the industrial or chemical process of purifying raw materials.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {精製|せいせい}{糖|とう}: refined sugar
- {精製|せいせい}⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧: refined salt
- {精製|せいせい}{水|すい}: purified water
- ⟦{石油|せきゆ}→石油：01448_sekiyu⟧{精製|せいせい}: petroleum refining
- {精製|せいせい}⟦{所|しょ}→〜所：09844_sho⟧/{精製|せいせい}⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧: refinery

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {精製|せいせい}: refining — removing impurities from raw materials
- ⟦{生成|せいせい}→生成：10895_seisei⟧: generation, formation — creating something new (homophone, different kanji)
- ⟦{製造|せいぞう}→製造：03289_seizou⟧: manufacturing — broader term for making products
- ⟦{精錬|せいれん}→精錬：21301_seiren⟧: smelting — specifically extracting metal from ore
- ⟦{浄化|じょうか}→浄化：14936_jouka⟧: purification — often used for water or air treatment
